usage_note: build_story.py regenerated data/story_text.json and data/events.json (skipped: 0); it is the only writer. No balance.json or sim.py edits.
playable: At cash >= win_cash at cycle end the game stops and shows the choice screen (Release / Stay as a corporation, with effect lines, no close). The pick shows the ending (name, text, stat line, epilogue if any) with New game / Main menu / Quit. Window end without goal shows END_LOSS + END_LOSS_STAT. Unanswered choice returns after reload (choice_pending saved); answered ending clears the save.
try_it: Debug menu: set cash to 9000+, press Next cycle. Pick a side. Headless check clean.
recording_hook: Signal main.run_ended(side, ending_id); side is RELEASE, CORP or LOSS. Fired once in main._finish().
